root_cause.description: The watchdog independently selected the newest successful capture, apply and postflight steps from a ten-run window, which could conceal a newer failed attempt and combine stages from different runs.

correction.ordinary_contract: Capture, apply, database postflight and configured idempotency must all succeed in the same retailer job, workflow run and commit.
correction.manual_dry_run_contract: A successful capture with intentionally skipped write stages remains visible as READ_ONLY_COMPLETE, does not count as an ordinary interval and does not replace the last complete apply.
correction.shared_workflow_isolation: Fit House and 10 Reps are selected by their exact capture step and retained job identity inside the shared workflow.
correction.allowed_split_run_exception: Only the existing eBay split-run-v1 attestation with exact apply/idempotency run bindings, same commit and zero-write idempotency remains allowed.

covered_incidents: newer failed attempt cannot be hidden by an older complete success
manual dry-run remains visible without becoming an ordinary success
Fit House and 10 Reps cannot borrow stages from each other
all terminal failure conclusions remain incomplete
generic non-eBay split-run evidence is rejected
exact idempotency step names are configuration-bound

decision.next_step: Merge through CI, then run the existing read-only watchdog from main and inspect its artifact. Do not dispatch a retailer refresh or widen monitored baselines.
